acceptance: For status=repair_required with recovered_operations containing chunking, declining repair displays the localized recovery information exactly once before the repair question.
After that decline, the project remains unopened and repair_project is not called.
For the same combined recovery-and-repair result, accepting repair still repairs and activates the project and displays the recovery information exactly once.
Ordinary successful project opening and recovery without follow-up repair retain their existing behavior without duplicate notices.
The self-heal remains automatic and post-hoc; no pre-confirmation, combined dialog, logging change, or localization-copy change is introduced.

The existing UX requirement is updated rather than duplicated, with exact affected paths, focused linked tests, and a companion spec reference; Project Lifecycle documentation describes the ordering guarantee.
Focused project-flow tests, the repository pytest gate, Ruff gate, traceability audit, and coverage audit pass.
assumptions: The existing localized recovery title and message remain the approved operator copy.
The recovery information dialog is shown exactly once before the follow-up repair confirmation whenever recovered_operations contains chunking, regardless of the repair choice.
Declining the follow-up repair continues to leave the project unopened and must not invoke repair_project.
alignment.reason: The ticket defines the desired ordering and explicitly excludes changing self-heal consent semantics. The implementation is a localized controller sequencing correction with deterministic UI regression coverage and no open product decision.
scope: In scope: reorder the existing Home recovery notification relative to the repair confirmation, add focused UI regression coverage, update the existing durable UX requirement and companion Cleanup/Chunking specification, and update Project Lifecycle documentation. Out of scope: service-level reset semantics, pre-confirmation for self-heal, new or combined dialogs, localization copy changes, logger changes, or other issue #40 tickets.
alignment.source: Gitea issue #34, prioritized by tracking issue #40 and read through authenticated tea CLI
alignment.understanding: When project opening has already self-healed incompatible Chunking data and the revalidation result also requires a separate manifest repair, Home must disclose the completed destructive reset before asking about that follow-up repair. Declining repair keeps the project unopened but must not suppress the recovery notice; accepting repair continues the established repair and activation flow without a duplicate notice.

C-0001 green: both accepted and declined combined recovery/repair cases showed recovery before the repair question; accepted repaired and activated, declined stayed unopened without repair.

intent.statement: Ensure the chunking self-heal recovery notice is shown when project opening also requires a follow-up repair and the operator declines that repair, as specified by Gitea issue #34.

examples: repair_required plus recovered_operations=[chunking], operator selects No: information precedes question and project stays unopened
repair_required plus recovered_operations=[chunking], operator selects Yes: information precedes question and is not repeated after activation
spec_items.statement: Home displays one localized Chunking recovery notice before requesting any follow-up project repair decision.
